purpose: Teach: 平坦/絶え間/見切り/感ずる/働きかける/釘付け/呼ばわり/叱り

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと一緒なら平坦な道のりよ
lines.en: If you're with your dad, Sho, the path ahead is smooth.
lines.style: Warm reassurance with a gentle lift at the end. Soft eye contact. The certainty of a mother who knows her child is safe with his father. Slow, steady pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが絶え間ない応援をして下さるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad is always cheering me on.
lines.style: Bright, open-hearted wonder. Voice rises slightly on the word 'cheering.' Quick, eager pacing. The genuine delight of a child marveling at being supported.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、安物のおもちゃは見切りを付けて整理しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's clean out those cheap toys and make some space, okay?
lines.style: Practical but not unkind. A gentle nudge, not a command. Slightly faster than the first line — efficient, purposeful. The cadence of a mother who gets things done without fuss.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの優しさを心で感ずるよ
lines.en: Mom, I can feel how kind Dad is, in my heart.
lines.style: Soft, sincere, slightly trembling with the effort of saying something true. Quiet pacing. The hesitation of a six-year-old finding words for something he deeply feels. A small voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに勉強の楽しさを働きかけるわね
lines.en: Sho, I'm going to help your dad show you how fun studying can be.
lines.style: Quiet determination. A mother planning something good. Steady, measured tone — not rushed. The slight lift of intention on 'help.' Maternal authority wrapped in encouragement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの絵に釘付けになったよ
lines.en: Mom, I was so mesmerized by Dad's drawing.
lines.style: Breathless admiration. The speed picks up as he talks about the drawing. Eyes wide. The unguarded enthusiasm of a child completely captivated by something his father made.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人をバカ呼ばわりしてはダメよ
lines.en: Sho, we don't call people foolish. You understand?
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A clear line drawn quietly. Direct eye contact. The voice doesn't raise, but it's unmistakable — this is a boundary. Calm, composed, brooking no argument.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに叱りつけられず優しく諭されたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad didn't scold me — he talked to me gently instead.
lines.style: Quiet wonder at kindness. Slightly slower pacing, as if marveling at something he's still processing. Vulnerable and earnest. The touching realization of a child who expected punishment and received patience.
